items.title: Sources: Essa Faal in Talks With NPP Over Possible 2026 Alliance
items.summary: By Fatou Touray Essa Mbye Faal, the APP-Sobeyaa presidential candidate, is in talks with President Adama Barrow’s National People’s Party over a possible political alliance ahead of the Dec. 5 presidential election, according to multiple sources familiar with the discussions. ...
items.author: Fatou Touray
